en: Fixed `/voice` saying voice mode changed when managed settings, `--settings`, or the project's `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` kept it as it was; it now says what holds it
zh: 修复当托管设置、`--settings` 或项目的 `.claude/settings.json` 或 `.claude/settings.local.json` 保持语音模式不变时，`/voice` 仍提示语音模式已更改的问题；现在会说明是什么在维持该设置
